# Wastewise — Market & Competition (Partner Meeting Note)

**Scope:** India, food-waste tracking *software* (recurring SaaS). GST extra, hardware one-time excluded. Figures rounded to nearest ₹1 cr.

## 1. Bottom-up sizing

**Blended ARPA: ₹63,744 / location / year (~₹5,312/mo)**

Simple average of 2025 observable software prices only:
`(BinSight ₹53,988 + Kitchen Ledger ₹72,000 + Scrapless ₹65,988 + Wastewise ₹63,000) / 4`

- BinSight: ₹4,499/mo ×12 = ₹53,988 [5, 2025 pricing page]
- Kitchen Ledger: ₹72,000/yr software only; ₹45,000 one-time kit excluded to keep TAM as ARR [5, 2025]
- Scrapless: ₹5,499/mo ×12 = ₹65,988 [5, 2025 page]; ₹2,499/mo [TechWire, 2021] stale होने से excluded
- Wastewise ACV: ₹63,000 [7] — शामिल ताकि list-price bias न रहे। Competitors-only average ₹63,992 होता, अंतर <0.5% — नतीजा robust है।

**Segment choice:**
- **TAM:** सभी organised outlets 7,42,000 [1] + institutional 96,000 [2] = 8,38,000 — long-term theoretical universe।
- **SAM:** सिर्फ Full-service 2,81,960 [1: 7,42,000×38%] + Institutional 96,000 [2] = 3,77,960 — आज serviceable।
- **SAM से बाहर:** QSR + cloud 3,85,840 [1: 7,42,000×52%] — Greenline [4] के अनुसार franchisor/aggregator tools में locked, "निकट भविष्य में buyer नहीं"; अन्य 74,200 cafés/bars/trucks [1: 10%] — low waste volume, कोई penetration evidence नहीं।

| Market | Locations (Inputs) | Formula (Locations × ₹63,744) | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| **TAM** | 8,38,000 = 7,42,000 [1] + 96,000 [2] | 8,38,000 × 63,744 | **₹5,342 cr** |
| **SAM** | 3,77,960 = 2,81,960 full-service + 96,000 institutional | 3,77,960 × 63,744 | **₹2,409 cr** |
| *o/w Full-service SAM* | 2,81,960 = 7,42,000×38% [1] | 2,81,960 × 63,744 | *₹1,797 cr* |
| *o/w Institutional SAM* | 96,000 [2] | 96,000 × 63,744 | *₹612 cr* |
| **Current penetrated market** | 19,019 = 8,459 + 10,560 (नीचे देखें) | 19,019 × 63,744 | **₹121 cr** |
| *o/w Full-service current* | 8,459 = 2,81,960×3% [4] | 8,459 × 63,744 | *₹54 cr* |
| *o/w Institutional current* | 10,560 = 96,000×11% [4] | 10,560 × 63,744 | *₹67 cr* |

**Read:** SAM, TAM का ~45% है; current (~₹121 cr) SAM value का सिर्फ ~5% है। Wastewise 410 locations [7] = penetrated base का ~2.2%, SAM locations का ~0.1%; ARR ~₹2.6 cr (410×₹63,000) = current का ~2.1% — headroom बड़ा, पर proof institutional retention में है (70% base institutional; 14% churn ज़्यादातर independent full-service में [7])।

## 2. Top-down cross-check

[3] का "₹35,000 cr" इस्तेमाल नहीं हो सकता — वह **global** और **hauling + composting + biogas समेत** all-in waste-management है, India software ARR नहीं। Reconcile के लिए चाहिए: India carve-out + सिर्फ tracking-software share (disposal/hauling/hardware हटाकर) + year/FX/methodology।

## 3. Competitor snapshot (per-location annual, GST extra)

| Company | Pricing / location / yr (source वर्ष) | Hardware model | Latest funding (confidence) | Wastewise के लिए implication |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **BinSight** (incumbent) | ₹53,988 (₹4,499/mo, 2025 page) [5] | अघोषित — hardware included vs अलग, खुलासा नहीं | ₹180 cr Series C (2023 press release) — **Medium:** primary पर 2 साल पुराना, runway अज्ञात | Price anchor सबसे नीचे; Wastewise ~17% premium पर ROI/churn story चाहिए, वरना full-service independents में undercut risk। |
| **Kitchen Ledger** | ₹72,000 software + ₹45,000 one-time kit (2025 page) [5]; Yr-1 TCO ~₹1,17,000 | Customer capex — upfront kit purchase | **₹115 cr Series B (12 Mar 2025 press release, Orchard Lane) — High;** aggregator का ₹330 cr [StartupWire, 2025] — **Low, disregard** | Best-funded direct rival, institutional-leaning (high ACV + capex सह सके)। Wastewise को institutional stickiness + lower upfront से compete करना होगा। |
| **Scrapless** | ₹65,988 (₹5,499/mo से शुरू, 2025 page); पुराना ₹2,499/mo (2021 article) stale — use न करें [5] | अघोषित | ₹12 cr seed (2022 press release) — **Medium:** primary पर पुराना व छोटा | 2021→2025 में ~120% list-price hike pricing power दिखाता है, पर Wastewise mid-priced है — discounting बिना जीते value (waste-saving %) साबित करनी होगी। |

## 4. Source reliability

| Source | Rating | एक-पंक्ति कारण |
|---|---|---|
| [1] Restaurant Census 2024 | Medium | Trade body का universe — दिशा सही, पर inflate करने का incentive, methodology opaque। |
| [2] Institutional Review 2024 | Medium | 96k का कोई triangulation नहीं; bias नहीं, पर precision कम। |
| [3] Wastewise blog ₹35k cr | Low | Marketing claim; geography (global) + category (hauling/biogas) mismatch। |
| [4] Greenline May 2025 | Medium | Penetration + QSR-exclusion thesis का single source; sample/method अज्ञात — sizing इसी पर टिका है। |
| [5] Pricing pages 2025 | High | Primary current list prices; सिर्फ तुलना योग्य। TechWire 2021 — Low (stale)। |
| [6] Funding: KL/BinSight/Scrapless press releases | High/Medium | Company releases factual पर dated (2022-23); KL के लिए ₹115 cr High, aggregator ₹330 cr Low (conflict)। |
| [7] Wastewise data room | Medium | Self-reported, unaudited छोटा base (n=410); churn की definition (logo vs revenue) verify करनी है। |

## 5. Founders के लिए open questions (5)

1. Full-service में chain vs independent split क्या है — 14% logo churn किस ticket-size/tenure पर, और institutional NRR/gross retention क्या है?
2. Realised price vs list क्या है — discount, hardware subsidy/lease, payback period और Yr-1 TCO Kitchen Ledger vs Wastewise?
3. QSR/cloud exclusion को तोड़ने का path है क्या — कोई franchisor/aggregator integration pilot या enterprise institutional pipeline (hotels/corporates)?
4. Greenline 3%/11% penetration का base और Wastewise win-rate vs BinSight/Kitchen Ledger — recent head-to-head wins/losses क्यों?
5. Per-location servicing cost (install, camera/scale failure, support) और institutional rollout में sales cycle — ₹63k ACV पर contribution margin कब scale होगा?
